description: This file defines a class `AOS_ProductsViewEdit` which extends the `ViewEdit` class, to customize the display logic for editing product records in SuiteCRM. It handles displaying and managing product images, including showing upload options and existing images.

classes.name: AOS_ProductsViewEdit
classes.description: A custom view class for editing product records, particularly handling product images display and deletion.
